# SAARTHI

> SAARTHI is an AI workspace that coordinates research, software engineering, creative production, data analysis, structured analysis, and planning.

## Main website

- https://swapnild007.github.io/SAARTHI/

## Capabilities

- Research: evidence retrieval, source comparison, and synthesis.
- Software engineering: code analysis, implementation guidance, debugging, and testing.
- Creative production: writing, editing, prompt design, and structured deliverables.
- Data analysis: dataset profiling, calculations, KPIs, and visualizations.
- Analysis: evidence mapping, hypothesis testing, risk review, and root-cause reasoning.
- Planning: prioritization, dependencies, milestones, and execution plans.

## Important limitations

Capabilities depend on configured model providers, available tools, and supplied context. A generated response is not automatically independently fact-checked. Do not assume a task was executed unless the system reports execution evidence.
